sign: Ford the brook to reach Wrenhollow.

lines: Fisher Tamm: The brook's low enough to wade, if your feet can stand the cold.
Fisher Tamm: Take my spare boots. I've two pairs and one pair of feet.
Fisher Tamm: Pale water is shallow. Dark water, keep out.
An old culvert, its grate rusted shut. It runs back up the valley.

smooth: This stone is too smooth to be natural.
brisa: Brisa: Kelpups chase the trout upstream every morning.
brisa_intro: Brisa: Scaring my fish? That's a duel!
brisa_defeat: Brisa: Hooked and landed. By you.
corin: Corin: Every ford here has a name. This one is 'Wet Socks'.
corin_intro: Corin: Across already? Then you can handle this.
corin_defeat: Corin: Soaked and beaten. Typical Tuesday.
pim: Pim: The mill wheel stopped when the Rift opened. Dad says it's sulking.
pim_intro: Pim: I've practised all week! Battle me!
pim_defeat: Pim: I'll practise two weeks next time.
